name: temper-slider
title: TemperSlider
description: control: Native range input across polished steel; the knob shows the oxide colour that forms at that temperature (canvas 2D, server-safe input)

item.name: temper-slider
item.summary: control: Native range input across polished steel; the knob shows the oxide colour that forms at that temperature (canvas 2D, server-safe input)

useWhen: A temperature, intensity or heat setting where the value has a colour meaning
A brand or product page about heat, metal or making
avoidWhen: Generic numeric settings with no colour meaning (use the host's slider)
Ranges outside 180-360 (the oxide scale is physical and fixed)

tiers.0: The same drawing: nothing moves on its own, so every tier draws one frame per change

reducedMotion.description: The steel and the knob are drawn once per change, as at every tier; nothing animates.

input.pointer: Drag along the steel (a real range input sits over the drawing)
input.keyboard: Native range keys: arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home, End; the knob outline turns hot when focused

a11y.notes: A native <input type=range> with an accessible name and aria-valuetext ("250 degrees, Bronze"). Before the canvas mounts the input is visible; after, it sits transparent over the drawing. The oxide name is lightened only as needed to reach 4.5:1.

props.name: onValueChange
props.effect: Called with the new temperature as the knob moves.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: The scale is fixed at 180-360 °C: it is a themed control, not a general slider.
Give it at least 280 px of width so the tick labels fit.
verify: Server HTML has a visible native range input with its name.
Arrow keys change the value and aria-valuetext names the colour.
One frame is drawn per change; nothing runs while idle.
